title: Ultimate-PackPL
body:
Welcome to an optimized Minecraft experience!
Ultimate-PackPL is a lightweight yet powerful Fabric modpack that enhances vanilla Minecraft without unnecessary bloat—just pure improvements. Perfect for smooth gameplay on lower-end hardware, with beautiful shaders and plenty of Quality of Life (QoL) features to make survival, exploration, and building more enjoyable.
This modpack is optimized for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric Loader 0.15.11), with full shader and replay support. It's compact in size, so it won't fill your drive with extras. Download, install via Prism Launcher, and dive in!
Key Features:

Performance Optimization: Higher FPS, lower RAM/CPU usage—even on older laptops—thanks to Sodium, Lithium, and Phosphor.
Beautiful Shaders: Enable Iris for realistic lighting, water, and skies. Compatible with packs like Complementary or BSL.
Improved HUD and UI: Minimap, hunger info, inventory overlays—all accessible without clutter.
QoL Tweaks: Fast item transfers, smooth loading, replay mod for capturing moments.
Vanilla+ Feel: Subtle enhancements that keep the core gameplay intact but make it better.

Core Mods (Dependencies Included):

Performance: Sodium (rendering), Lithium (physics/AI), Phosphor (lighting), FerriteCore (memory), Smooth Boot.
Graphics: Iris (shaders), Indium (Sodium+Iris compatibility), ReplayMod (recording).
Tools: Xaero's Minimap, AppleSkin (food info), Mouse Tweaks (drag&drop), Inventory HUD+.
HUD/UI: Better Mount HUD, Apple HUD, Dark Loading Screen, SmoothScrolling Everywhere.
Other QoL: Armor HUD, Version Checker, No Chat Reports, VoxelMap (minimap alternative).

Full mod list and configs are bundled. Check logs if issues arise, or comment below!
Requirements and Installation:

Minecraft: 1.21.1 or newer (1.21.1 recommended).
Loader: Fabric 0.15+.
Launcher: Prism, CurseForge, or Modrinth App—one-click install.
Shaders: Download separately from Modrinth (e.g., Complementary Reimagined) and place in shaderpacks folder.

Why choose it? Vanilla Minecraft is great, but these mods make it epic—lag-free, visually stunning, and convenient. Tested on mid-range PC (i7 + GTX 1650): 200+ FPS on ultra.
Thanks for downloading! Leave a star or feedback if you enjoy it. Subscribe for updates. Happy crafting!
